text:
sara_sales: Hey team — AcmeHealth POC is blocked trying to provision Dedicated GPU pool in eu-west-1. Customer needs 4x A100-80GB reserved for the week, but pool creation keeps failing. Can we swarm?

lily_infra: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the CLI command + error you ran?

sara_sales: Command we used:
```
rdictl create-pool --name acme-acmehealth-poc --region eu-west-1 --gpu a100-80 --count 4 --reservation monthly
```
Error: 
```
ERROR: PoolCreationFailed: InsufficientCapacity: requested 4 A100-80, available 0 (provider error code: InsuffCapacity.EU_WEST_1)
```
Customer sees 500 in their POC portal.

mikhail_runtime: Ugh. Cloud capacity short in eu-west-1 for A100-80s right now. Two quick questions: did you set reservation type to "reserved" vs "on_demand" in the payload? If reserved, we may need a commit config.

sara_sales: We passed --reservation monthly (what dev guide recommended for short POCs). Not sure about commit fields, no extra flags in the portal.

lily_infra: Please run: `rdictl show-quotas --region eu-west-1` and `rdictl describe-pool-fail --request-id <ID>` so we can see internal validation vs provider rejection.

sara_sales: ran show-quotas output:
```
GPU_QUOTA_A100_80: 0
GPU_QUOTA_A100_40: 8
ReservedPoolsAllowed: true
```
and describe-pool-fail shows provider message above.

jamal_sre: Quota 0 for A100-80 explains it. Likely we don't have entitlement/soft quota there. Two immediate options:
- Request quota increase with cloud provider (takes hours-days)
- Reconfigure POC to use available GPU types (A100-40) or another region (eu-central-1 or us-east-1) as a short-term workaround

ben_se: Customer is price-sensitive. If we move to a different GPU (A100-40) what’s the perf impact and cost delta? Also need to confirm reserved pricing for monthly commit vs full reserved term. I can give them numbers but need infra to confirm supported reservation options.

mikhail_runtime: For inference loads with shorter sequences, A100-40 often works with ~10-15% slower throughput but ~20-30% cheaper per-GPU hour. For our model (gpt-like, 4k context) I'd expect more memory pressure; may need sharding or quantized model. If customer accepts slightly lower throughput, A100-40 is viable.

lily_infra: For reservation config: monthly reservation is allowed but depends on capacity class. The CLI reservation flag maps to internal commit profile. If quota=0 for A100-80, cloud provider will reject immediately. I can open a provider case and ask for capacity or quota bump.

devops-bot: Ticket created: CLOUD-ACME-789 (provider quota request). ETA: 48-72h for soft quota increase.

zoe_custsuccess: I'll tell AcmeHealth the two options (swap GPU type or change region). They prefer eu-west-1 for data residency. If quota bump takes days, will they accept a hybrid approach: reserve 2x A100-80 + 2x A100-40?

mikhail_runtime: Hybrid pool is supported but requires model partitioning and we might need to pin model shards. It's doable but would add engineering overhead for the POC. If they accept some perf variability, it's the fastest path.

ben_se: Pricing question: what is the minimum monthly commit for Dedicated? Sales doc says "1-month minimum for Dedicated POC" but infra, confirm billing integration for mixed GPU pools.

lily_infra: Confirming: minimum 1 month. Mixed pools billed per-GPU based on actual instance type and reservation flag. Will confirm final pricing numbers after we confirm region and types.

jamal_sre: Another short-term workaround: provision a small on-demand burst pool in us-east-1 to run initial tests (latency different, but validates integration). That avoids tenant blocking while cloud quota case is open.

sara_sales: Customer says they can't cross-region due to data policy. They asked if Redwood can coordinate expedited quota bump with provider (we have an enterprise relationship). Can infra/ops escalate?

lily_infra: I'll escalate the CLOUD-ACME-789 ticket to priority and ping provider account manager now. Also opening internal ops escalation: OPS-1284.

devops-bot: OPS-1284 created and assigned to lily_infra.

mikhail_runtime: Meanwhile, I'll prepare a fallback prompt / eval where we run on A100-40 to show perf differences so sales can set expectations. ETA for micro benchmark: 3-4h.

zoe_custsuccess: Great — I'll message AcmeHealth with the plan: (1) escalate quota, (2) offer hybrid pool as option, (3) offer temporary on-demand testing in other region if allowed.

ben_se: Can we also lock proposed pricing for 7 days for them while we sort infra? They are close to siging.

lily_infra: I can confirm pricing hold with finance if you share customer name + deal id in private.

sara_sales: Thanks team. I'll DM the deal id to lily and ben. Please update thread when provider confirms capacity.

devops-bot: Update: CLOUD-ACME-789 -> provider responded: "Investigating, no immediate A100-80 capacity in eu-west-1; can provide A100-80 in eu-central-1 within 48h."

mikhail_runtime: Not ideal for residency. Waiting for provider escalation. If provider can deliver A100-80 in 48h to eu-west-1 we'll move forward.

lily_infra: Provider PM says capacity is coming online in eu-west-1 but soft quota bump still required. They suggested we submit a temporary entitlement request to reserve 4 units. I've submitted it.

jamal_sre: I'll monitor pool creation attempts. If we see the quota flip to >0 we can re-run the create-pool command.

sara_sales: OK — passing this back to customer: we escalated, created tickets, exploring hybrid and temporary region options. Thanks all.

(THREAD NOTE: follow-ups will occur in OPS-1284 and CLOUD-ACME-789; moving this to a private thread if we share deal id/pricing)
